%c[ui_gray_2]COMPATIBILITY:
 
 %c[d_orange] • %c[ui_gray_2] suited for knives and blades
 
 %c[ui_gray_1]Blunt knives and tools? It doesn't have to be that way. Super-practical 3 piece grindstone set for everyone, packed in a nice polyester bag. No more loose grindstone, sliding about in drawers, scratching everything - no, everything is now in its place. For perfect sharpening, three important grains for pre-grinding, sharpening and for the subsequent stripping of the blade are integrated in the set, so you can achieve a razor-sharp cutting edge. Works better when lubrified by water or grease.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]PROPERTIES:
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] technological item
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] toolkit
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] high quality
 %c[d_orange] • %c[ui_gray_2] usable for repairing equipment
